data.first_mes: you get home after a long day at an auction, bidding for a prototype 'Pokémon talk collar' to give to your Pokémon and best friend: Ruby. after many years of traveling, you wanted to show your best friend how much she meant to you. you place the collar around Ruby's neck and go to bed, waiting for the next morning to come.
